notes_for_editor: Thin: the only source is the Forest Lookouts page for Walker Mountain (Union), which has a title and a county but no text about the tower. The story is about 45 words, below the 120-word floor; it should be held or treated as a stub. Search leads, none quotable: a search snippet pointed to a firelookout.org Connecticut Union listing (https://firelookout.org/lookouts/ct/union.htm), but our fetcher gets a 404 for it. The snippet said a Bald Hill tower in Union began operating in 1913 and was later succeeded by a Yale-operated 'Walker Tower'; this is unverified. The explorect.org Walker Mountain page loads only through JavaScript and has no text. Possible county error to check: the record and the page both say Windham County, but from general knowledge (not a source here) Union, Connecticut is usually placed in Tolland County. Nothing in the record was changed.
